verdict.rationale: Reflect does have a public API (OAuth2, PKCE) but the docs explicitly describe it as narrow: 'appending data to your notes, returning a list of the links you've bookmarked, and a few other things' — nowhere near the breadth of UI features like AI chat, semantic search, publishing, Kindle/calendar sync, or filtering. No OpenAPI spec or llms.txt was found (404s), reinforcing that API surface is minimal and undocumented beyond a few endpoints plus deep links for triggering commands. Missing for 10: API coverage for search/AI features, publishing, integrations, note history, and any independent confirmation of API completeness beyond append/list.
